games.title: Kelvi
games.description: A question drops. Answer fast. Protect the streak.
games.imageAlt: A visual spread of South Indian cultural clues: a veena, filter coffee, jasmine, a temple gopuram, kolam, and an auto rickshaw.

games.title: Kolam Kraze
games.description: Read the dots. Complete the pattern. Do not blink.
games.imageAlt: A hand drawing a white kolam of looping lines and dots on a textured floor, with jasmine, rice flour, and turmeric nearby.

games.title: Sabha Canteen
games.description: Know the menu, read the room, survive the season.
games.imageAlt: Filter coffee, banana-leaf tiffin, and a concert programme on a green marble sabha canteen table.

games.title: Pallanguzhi
games.description: The old counting game, sharpened for a new round.
games.imageAlt: A carved wooden pallanguzhi board on sunlit stone, with cowrie shells and tamarind seeds in its pits.

games.title: Aadu Puli Aattam
games.description: One side has numbers. The other has teeth.
games.imageAlt: Brass tigers and ivory goats arranged on a triangular Aadu Puli Aattam board over deep blue cloth.
